truth.absolute_time: current_year is persisted and deterministic keys continue with absolute year after restore
truth.patch_truth: patch definitions + EnvironmentSample + Rect2 geometry persisted as research inputs
truth.population_truth: adult cohorts and seed-bank cohorts persisted directly; no per-plant reconstruction
truth.strategy_truth: PlantGenome and P2.2 recruitment traits persisted with accepted checksums
truth.regional_truth: history, occupancy, transition, migration and disturbance logs + cumulative accounting persisted
truth.diagnostic_truth: accepted P2.7 divergence result persisted as diagnostic evidence; no species identity declared
truth.format: typed JSON envelope with canonical order-independent integrity hashing
truth.numeric_variant_contract: TYPE_INT is tagged explicitly; TYPE_FLOAT, Vector2 and Rect2 use exact Godot Variant bytes encoded as base64 so JSON never rewrites their binary value
truth.production_boundary: research persistence proof only; no production durability/transactions/authority claim

controlled_design.required_equality: P2.6 baseline result_hash == stateful uninterrupted result_hash == double-save/restart result_hash

codec_finding_001.root_cause: Godot JSON.parse_string restores untagged integer JSON numbers as TYPE_FLOAT, erasing TYPE_INT identity required by canonical hashing.
codec_finding_001.repair: encode TYPE_INT with an explicit Int wrapper and restore with int(value)

codec_finding_002.root_cause: On the exact attached Godot a13da4feb build, JSON.stringify(..., full_precision=true) followed by JSON.parse_string can restore an adjacent TYPE_FLOAT value. P2.8 canonical hashing uses %.17f, so this changes world/evidence/checkpoint hashes for ordinary computed ecology doubles.

attached_engine_range_probe.range: computed values centered in ecological-scale [-1000,1000] inputs

codec_finding_002.repair: encode TYPE_FLOAT, Vector2 and Rect2 using var_to_bytes -> base64 and decode base64 -> bytes_to_var with exact expected Variant type checks
codec_finding_002.strengthened_preflight: adds adversarial computed-scale doubles, tiny double, exact Variant-byte equality for float/Vector2/Rect2, and fail-closed accumulated assertion status

failure_stage_localization.runner_order: acceptance parser -> failure-stage parser -> codec preflight -> fail-closed execution stage probe -> full P2.7 parent regression -> P2.8 acceptance -> fresh process A/B
failure_stage_localization.checkpoint_failure_diagnostics: prints restored world validation plus stored/original/restored world and evidence hashes and recomputed checkpoint hash
failure_stage_localization.variant_audit: prints unsupported value types or non-string dictionary keys if serialization returns empty

next_if_stage_passes: run full P2.8 runner; if full PASS, accept P2.8 and close EVO1
next_if_stage_fails: repair only the named P2.8 boundary and preserve accepted P2.7 and earlier sources
